title: Correlation Geometry of Quantum Sensor Networks: Local-Global Information Flow and Local Privacy
summary: Quantum sensor networks (QSN) typically encode N unknown parameters while targeting a single linear combination, rendering the N-1 remaining parameters as nuisance directions. To rigorously quantify estimation precision under such nuisances, we use the effective quantum Fisher information (EQFI) and establish a ``barrel-effect'' bottleneck: the global EQFI cannot exceed the weakest weighted local sensing capacity.
